text.tspan: Requests are for the scheduler, limits are for the kernel
pod A uses 0.3 · pod B uses 0.4
CPU over its limit → THROTTLED (slowed), never killed
Memory over its limit → OOMKilled (exit code 137)
QoS class = eviction order when the node runs low
2nd Burstable: some requests or limits set
last Guaranteed: requests = limits for CPU and memory
